svg.text: Organic / inorganic waste sorting with MobileNetV2 on ESP32-S3-CAM, fill-level, gas & climate sensing, ESP32 main controller
C1 absorbs the servo current spikes
MobileNetV2 int8 128x128: organic / paper / plastic / metal
ECHO is 5 V: the 1k / 2k divider gives 3.3 V for the ESP32
AO up to 5 V: 10k / 20k divider -> max 3.3 V on GPIO35
TITLE: Edge-AI Smart Dustbin - Main Schematic
net label: all pins with the same name are connected (as in Proteus ISIS)
UART 115200: U1 TX2 -> U2 RX, U2 TX -> U1 RX2
